existing_group_assignments.rationale: Inhibition of PPAR alpha concerns the same receptor as the other PPARalpha binding/activity/activation events but is a distinct process.
Inhibition of mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation is the same endpoint as Decrease, Fatty acid beta-oxidation.
Increase in LH, with differing context specificity relative to the anterior pituitary secretion event.
Collagen accumulation is a cellular process contributing to fibrosis, so it is flagged as a context difference from organ-level fibrosis.
Increase, Liver fibrosis is the same process (fibrosis) as the existing group members, in a liver context.

new_groups.rationale: Thyroperoxidase inhibition and decreased thyroid hormone synthesis relate to the thyroid hormone synthesis pathway but are distinct objects and processes, flagged for curator review.
